title: Google Play DEX Optimization, Edge-to-Edge Compliance & Theme Enhancements
releaseNotes: Battery Exemption Theme Alignment: Background alert prompt now adapts faithfully to Morning Sun, Midnight, OLED, Violet, and Emerald themes.
Edge-to-Edge Compliance: Upgraded Android 15 edge-to-edge window handling for seamless full-screen display.
DEX Code Optimization: Enhanced R8 bytecode shrinking and obfuscation satisfying Google Play publishing standards.
